item.title: my first note
item.description:
I was watching an interview of Richard Stallman with a journalist that turned into a heated debate about Free vs Proprietary software which nsadly is not the topic of the current text. Richard also mentioned Free vs Open Source Software and how they are nothing alike. In order to understand where the distinction lies, we first need to clarify the definitions.

So what is a free software?

According to GNU a software is considered to be free when it satisfies the four essential freedoms:
